title: Verified phone number as biometric precondition
details: Add a phone column, SMS verification flow, and accept 1 verified email + 1 verified phone as an alternative biometric precondition. Requires an SMS provider (e.g. Twilio, Vonage) as a new dependency with running costs.
resolution: Deferred by owner decision Q5 (2026-10-16): no SMS cost for now. Recovery email or 2FA serve as the second factor instead.
